policy.renderRule: Only slices with status 'verified' render; 'pending'/'blocked' show a placeholder state.
policy.readOnly: Guy consumes published Chronos/Tibot manifests read-only and never mutates Axone source data.
policy.leakage: Tier-3 targets are labels only — never Tibot features or live inference.

tiers.label: Technical features
tiers.desc: TA-v3 causal feature columns derived from raw OHLCV.

tiers.label: Ground-truth targets
tiers.desc: Label-only predictive targets (purged/embargoed; never live features).

tiers.label: Models & predictions
tiers.desc: Selected/alternative models, timestamp-aligned predictions, confidence & metrics.

gateA.label: Gate A — Tibot Tier-4 export contract
gateA.description: Tier-4 predictions render only after Gate A passes and Tibot emits hash-manifested dashboard exports. Contract coordinated with Tibot on pass.
